allergy may be a risk factor for autism.
allergy induced autism may be an area of research that needs more attention in the future.
allergic manifestations are associated with increased serum levels of brain-specific auto- antibodies in some autistic children.

the possible role of allergy in the pathogenesis of autism.

the possible role of allergy in inducing the production of brain-specific auto- antibodies in autistic patients.

allergy may induce the production and accumulation of brain specific autoantibodies, in a subgroup of children with autism.
